title: Super Session: Future-Proofing Your Design Career in the Age of AI
overview: The panel discusses how AI serves as a collaborator that automates routine tasks without replacing creative judgment, emphasizing the enduring value of uniquely human skills like storytelling and empathy. They explore strategies for reskilling, portfolio development, ethical considerations, and the importance of community and mentorship in adapting to AI-driven changes in design.

highlights.label: AI as a collaborator, not a replacement
Case studies: AI-generated vs AI-assisted work
